_comment: Independent C-first Levitation-gated kick_door attempt for dokick.c. The source route requires a closed-door target with a wall or door immediately behind the hero so dokick's brace guard passes; kick_door's Levitation arm then calls kick_ouch, which calls hurtle. This Healer debug-role seed/input variation wished and quaffs Levitation, moves south once, then kicks west at the source-mapped door target. C run-1pv0Fw exposes the first setup miss: the wished potion is letter k, not o, so the input never moves south or reaches dokick. Preserve this exact outcome outside recordings.
